package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type node struct {
	next, prev *node
	Value      int
}

type ring struct {
	root node
	len  int
}

func newRing() *ring {
	r := &ring{}
	r.root.next = &r.root
	r.root.prev = &r.root
	return r
}

func (r *ring) insert(n, at *node) *node {
	n.prev = at
	n.next = at.next
	n.prev.next = n
	n.next.prev = n
	r.len++
	return n
}

func main() {
	r := newRing()
	a := r.insert(&node{Value: 1}, r.root.prev)
	b := r.insert(&node{Value: 2}, r.root.prev)
	// The dependency writes through a pointer whose pointee is cyclic: the
	// write comes back finitely and lands on the original storage.
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Value":7}`), a); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(a.Value, b.Value, b.prev.Value, r.len)
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Value":9}`), b.prev); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(a.Value, r.root.next.Value)
}
